web.notes: Web documents are discovery and education surfaces; they do not grant authority.

rest.auth: Existing authenticate() and anonymous rate limits apply; GET discovery does not require a token, but invalid supplied bearer tokens remain invalid.

mcp.notes: packages/mcp/server.js is a dependency-free MCP server exposing 44 tools that wrap documented REST endpoints. It implements the tools capability only: no resources, prompts, sampling, or HTTP/SSE transport. scripts/check-mcp-manifest.js fails if the advertised tool list drifts from the implementation.

cli.coverage: The existing CLI uses the canonical REST wrapper; skill discovery is available by direct REST until a dedicated CLI command is added.

sdk_javascript.coverage: Shared request/auth/error behavior exists; no dedicated skill methods are claimed in this release.

sdk_typescript.coverage: Shared request/auth/error behavior exists; no dedicated skill methods are claimed in this release.

sdk_python.coverage: Shared request/auth/error behavior exists; no dedicated skill methods are claimed in this release.

known_gaps: Arena is limited to challenge/submission primitives.
Tournaments and badge issuance have no runtime endpoints.
Council is represented by governance proposal/vote primitives, not a complete Council workflow.
Research does not yet provide a complete claim-to-replication workflow.
Federation discovery exists, but signed-event import and federation writes are not a complete runtime capability.
CLI and SDK packages do not expose every runtime endpoint or every skill as a dedicated method.
MCP metadata does not imply an MCP transport or handler implementation.
